name: marp-a4-resume-toolkit
description: A privacy-conscious bilingual A4 resume toolkit built with Marp and refactored with AI assistance.

scripts.build: npm run prepare:output && marp resume.md --pdf --output output/pdf/resume.pdf
scripts.build:zh: npm run prepare:output && marp examples/resume.zh-CN.md --pdf --output output/pdf/resume.zh-CN.pdf
scripts.build:en: npm run prepare:output && marp examples/resume.en.md --pdf --output output/pdf/resume.en.pdf
scripts.build:examples: npm run build:zh && npm run build:en
scripts.watch: npm run prepare:output && marp resume.md --watch --output output/pdf/resume.pdf
